## 1. Product Mission and Outcome

### 1.1 Product Mission Statement

> **ParcelTrack**: give every Australian Post customer real-time parcel visibility
> and proactive delivery control, from drop-off to doorstep.

### 1.2 Product Outcome

| Dimension | Target | Measurement |
|---|---|---|
| **Value** | -15% tracking-inquiry contact volume | contact-centre ticket count vs baseline |
| **Outcome** | 98% on-time accurate tracking status | % of parcels with correct status in window |
| **Experience** | NPS +20 | post-delivery NPS survey |
| **Adoption** | 80% of AU customers on the app in 12 months | MAU / registered customers |

### 1.3 Product Principles

1. **Outcomes over outputs** — delivery measured by customer value, not artefacts.
2. **AU data sovereignty** — customer PII and delivery data never leave-country.
3. **Progressive, reversible delivery** — every release is safe to roll back.
4. **Zero-trust integration** — no standing lateral trust between product components.

## 2. Cross-Functional Team Composition

### 2.1 Team Structure

Permanent cross-functional team **T-Parcel** (owns ParcelTrack end-to-end):

| Role | Name | Responsibility |
|------|------|----------------|
| Product Owner | J. Tan | Backlog, outcomes, customer voice |
| Product Architect | T. Nguyen | Guardrails, ADRs, product-arch decisions |
| Lead Engineer | M. Rao | Real-time pipeline, integration |
| AI Safety Engineer | S. Park | Advisory model safety, PII handling |
| DevOps | K. Williams | Deployment, observability, reversibility |
| QA | L. Chen | Definition-of-done, regression |

### 2.2 Architect Role

Sets guardrails, owns ADRs, enforces compliance-as-code, keeps delivery reversible.

## 3. Product Backlog with Architecture Items

| Epic | Architecture item | Linked ADR |
|------|-------------------|-----------|
| A — Real-time tracking pipeline | Event-sourced tracking events | ADR-001 |
| B — AI delivery advisory | Network-isolated inference (no PII egress) | ADR-002 |
| C — Customer comms automation | Consent-aware messaging | ADR-003 |

## 4. Release Architecture Roadmap

| Wave | Content | Gate criteria |
|------|---------|---------------|
| 1 | Real-time tracking GA | compliance-as-code pass; NPS baseline held |
| 2 | AI delivery advisory | isolation test harness green; safety review |
| 3 | Comms automation | consent/APP-11 check embedded |

## 5. Value Stream Mapping

Order-to-delivery: **Drop-off → In-Transit tracking → Advisory → Delivery → Proof**.
Target cycle time < 5 s for tracking status; advisory p95 < 1500 ms.

## 6. Embedded Compliance Per Feature

- Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) APPs; **APP-11** data security in every feature DoD.
- **Consent-aware PII handling**; AU data-residency check on every feature.
- Compliance-as-code gates block release on any APP violation.
